_comment: Static plan model for phase 4. Hand-curated from docs/roadmap/2026-10-23-phase-4-plan.md at
phase.plan_sha on phase.plan_ref, and from each ticket's own 'Depends on' row on GitHub: quoted,
never inferred. Where an edge comes from the plan rather than the ticket, its 'what' says so.
generate.py joins this against live GitHub state. Nothing here is a live value: priorities, ADR
titles and statuses, milestone dates and counts, issue and PR states are all read on every run,
so this file changes only when the plan, a ticket's stated dependency or an owner changes.

risks.text: The daily cadence of #125 rests on one account; a second is to be named before job 2.
Baha carries #63, #122 and #62; #62 slips if the first two take the month. The alternative is Burak taking #62 after #60, which moves the ablation behind the first fit.
PR #79 has been in review since September; lane 2's bands are invisible without it.
Every number this plan rests on is a laptop measurement; Burak's desktop batch is owed before any figure leaves the provisional state.

Dr. Akba's double-check of the direction change (A7, the paper's focus) has not been sought; the decisions register's 2026-10-03 arrangement makes the lead the approver, and the lead should say in the register that this plan is covered by it, or ask.
